title: guard let: Validate a Sign-up
hints: `guard` states what must be true and exits early otherwise; its bindings stay in scope afterwards.
Write one `guard` per rule, in order, each returning its own error message.
`guard let username, (3...16).contains(username.count) else { return "bad username" }` — and split the email with `omittingEmptySubsequences: false`.
